scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && mkdir -p APK_DISTRIBUTION && cp -f android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk APK_DISTRIBUTION/Biochar-Management-System-v1.0.0.apk && echo '✅ APK built successfully at APK_DISTRIBUTION/Biochar-Management-System-v1.0.0.apk'
scripts.build:apk-v2: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && sed -i '' 's/versionCode 1/versionCode 2/g' app/build.gradle && sed -i '' 's/versionName "1.0"/versionName "2.0"/g' app/build.gradle && ./gradlew assembleRelease && sed -i '' 's/versionCode 2/versionCode 1/g' app/build.gradle && sed -i '' 's/versionName "2.0"/versionName "1.0"/g' app/build.gradle && cd .. && mkdir -p APK_DISTRIBUTION && cp -f android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk APK_DISTRIBUTION/Biochar-Management-Pro-v2.0.0.apk && echo '✅ APK v2.0.0 built successfully at APK_DISTRIBUTION/Biochar-Management-Pro-v2.0.0.apk'
scripts.build:apk-v3: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && sed -i '' 's/versionCode 1/versionCode 3/g' app/build.gradle && sed -i '' 's/versionName "1.0"/versionName "3.0"/g' app/build.gradle && ./gradlew assembleRelease && sed -i '' 's/versionCode 3/versionCode 1/g' app/build.gradle && sed -i '' 's/versionName "3.0"/versionName "1.0"/g' app/build.gradle && cd .. && mkdir -p APK_DISTRIBUTION && cp -f android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk APK_DISTRIBUTION/Biochar-Management-Pro-v3.0.0.apk && echo '✅ APK v3.0.0 built successfully at APK_DISTRIBUTION/Biochar-Management-Pro-v3.0.0.apk'
scripts.build:all-versions: npm run build:apk && npm run build:apk-v2 && npm run build:apk-v3 && echo '✅ All version APKs built successfully!'
scripts.install:apk: adb install -r APK_DISTRIBUTION/Biochar-Management-System.apk || echo '⚠️  No device connected. Connect your Android device and enable USB debugging.'
